Venha fazer parte da Cyncly!

title: Senior Application Scientist And Business Partnerships Executive
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Application Scientist And Business Partnerships Executive em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location

Brazil (remote)


Summary of the role

As a Senior Application Scientist, you will play a crucial role in bridging scientific knowledge with practical application. In this full-time position, you’ll be at the forefront of driving the development of our tools, through understanding and addressing our members’ needs. By fostering strong relationships with our members and internal teams, you’ll support Lhasa in developing cutting-edge software solutions, which solve real-world chemical safety assessment problems, whilst generating new leads across core industry sectors. In this role you are accountable for increasing revenue through the sponsorship of our in-silico solutions across our core industry sectors.


Main Responsibilities:

Include but are not limited to:

  • Engage with members to ensure retention by understanding regional scientific and regulatory challenges.
  • Develops market research and business intelligence strategies for relevant sectors to increase revenue through the sponsorship of our in-silico solutions.
  • Promote Lhasa’s solutions to drive adoption and revenue growth by upselling solutions to current members.
  • Identify and develop business relationships with prospects from various industries.
  • Respond to enquiries and deliver tailored demonstrations of Lhasa’s software solutions.
  • Translate complex scientific developments into practical applications for members and prospects.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with members, prospects, and regulators.
  • Deliver training sessions and provide ongoing scientific support to members.
  • Represent and support Lhasa at scientific events, conferences, webinars, and exhibitions.
  • Contribute to external communications, including posts, videos, and other promotional content.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align regional activities with global strategy.


Attributes:

  • Strong scientific background in chemistry, toxicology, degradation, or metabolism, or an undergraduate degree, masters, or PhD in a relevant scientific field.
  • Proof of at least 3 years of experience in relevant industry (e.G. cosmetics, pharmaceutical, food, agrochemicals)
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Understanding of chemical structures and the application of in silico predictions
  • Knowledge of toxicology, metabolism, degradation, and organic reaction mechanisms
  • Experience in customer-facing roles, ideally in a scientific or technical environment.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently as well as collaboratively
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Able to work as part of a multidisciplinary team and independently
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, Spanish is desirable
  • Alignment with Lhasa’s values and mission

title: Global Payroll & Compensation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Payroll & Compensation Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S.
-Based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, Carnegie, Flywire, YipitData, Niche, and BellXcel.

We are looking for a skilled Global Payroll and Compensation Manager to join our Finance team and take ownership of global payroll and compensation operations for employees and contractors.

This role is critical to ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll execution while supporting the company’s financial operations in a fully remote, international environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end global payroll processes for employees and contractors as part of the Finance function
  • Ensure accurate calculation and timely payment of salaries, bonuses, reimbursements, and other compensation components
  • Review and validate time-tracking data prior to payroll processing
  • Coordinate, review, and approve benefits-related requests in collaboration with HR and external providers
  • Process payroll-related payments via banks and international payment systems
  • Partner with EOR providers to manage payroll operations across multiple countries
  • Act as a key Finance team contact for payroll and compensation-related inquiries
  • Ensure payroll data accuracy, proper documentation, and confidentiality
  • Support financial reporting by providing payroll-related data and reconciliations
  • Collaborate closely with Legal, HR, and external partners to improve payroll and compensation processes


Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in payroll, compensation, or finance-related roles
  • Proven experience managing payroll for employees and contractors
  • Solid understanding of payroll processes within a Finance function
  • Experience working with banks and international payment systems
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Good command of English (written and spoken)


Nice to Have

  • Experience working with EOR (Employer of Record) services
  • Background in EOR and recruitment services
  • Experience using QuickBooks
  • Experience supporting payroll in global, remote-first companies


What We Offer

  • Full-time remote role with flexible working arrangements
  • Opportunity to work in a global, fast-growing environment
  • Collaboration with international teams and partners
  • Competitive compensation package



Kindly submit your up-to-date CV in English.

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Us
Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.
At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.
Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.
Role Overview
As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.
2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.
3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble
4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.
5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.
6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.
7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.
8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology
9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately
80 hours of audio content
within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.
10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery
Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.
Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.
Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.
Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.
Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English
This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo writer (brasil) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Promo Writer
Location: Remote
Position Type: Contract
Company: Pocket FM
About Us
At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.
Role Overview
As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.
The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.
You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.
Key Responsibilities
1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing
- Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. - Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. - Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. - Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. - Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series.
2. Adaptation & Localization
- Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. - Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. - Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. - Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts.
3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement

- Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. - Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. - Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. - Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response.
7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization
- Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. - Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. - Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. - Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.
Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. - Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. - Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. - Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. - Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. - Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. - Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. - Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. - Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. - Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.
Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.

title: Senior ai agent engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ai agent engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About First Ignite
First Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.
The role We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse. The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a person reviews before anything happens with it. Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision, traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.
What you'll do • Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling, included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK, Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud. • Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation. • Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch. • Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses. Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task. • Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate. • Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable. Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both. • Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as regression tests. • Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality. • Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy. • Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to you.
Required Qualifications: • 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real users touched. • You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about a multi-step run. • You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and turned them into something an agent can call reliably. • You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against a structured source of truth. • You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included. • You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and what to do about it. • You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question being asked instead of a nearby one. • You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval for them. • You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust. • You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the furthest east we can go. You might currently be titled AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll go on what you've shipped.
Preferred Qualifications: • You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking. • You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AI Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong. • You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance. • You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences. • You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

Confira esta oportunidade para Head of business & operations (brazil resident) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.

Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.

What you'll do Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company

What you'll bring

Must-have Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires

Nice-to-have Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

title: Member of the board of advisors
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Member of the board of advisors em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.

Company Website:

About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors

Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.

We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.

Key Responsibilities

Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network. Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships. Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement. Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate. Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.

Preferred Qualifications Passion for football and the business of sports. Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader. Strong professional network that can support club growth. Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

Compensation & Benefits

This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.

Why Join Us

Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

description:

REMOTE ANALYTICS AND AUTOMATION SPECIALIST TO WORK WITH SYDNEY, AUSTRALIA AGENCY. 

About The Role

SOMO is a Sydney-based performance marketing and digital agency, with a small London presence, hiring a Digital Analytics & Automation Specialist to help deliver on a services agreement with a major client, spanning analytics administration, technical implementation, measurement strategy, and workflow automation. This is a hands-on role covering everyday system hygiene through to building automated processes that reduce manual reporting and operational overhead.

The role is structured around three core service pillars, plus a growing automation function.

Working Hours & Availability

This role reports into a Sydney-based team, so overlap with Sydney business hours is essential :

Core availability window (required): 9:00am–1:00pm Sydney time (AEST/AEDT), every working day The remaining hours of your 8-hour day are flexible and can be worked to suit your own schedule/timezone Given Brazil's timezone difference, this core window will typically fall in the evening to midnight for a Brazil-based hire, candidates should confirm this is workable for them before applying

Key Responsibilities

1. Admin Tasks (system hygiene & operational support)

Manage platform access (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio)

Update dashboard permissions

Set up and maintain scheduled reports/emails

Conduct system hygiene audits

Maintain progress tracking documentation

Acknowledge and resolve routine requests within same-day/1-business-day turnaround

2. Implementation Tasks (technical setup & troubleshooting)

Configure event tracking (form submissions, button clicks, etc.)

Build and maintain dashboards, with a strong emphasis on advanced Looker Studio usage and setup (GA4 also used)

Pull data from third-party platforms via APIs and manage API integrations

Perform ad hoc data extractions

Troubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms

Support integrations with other third-party systems as needed

3. Strategy Tasks (consultative & planning support)

Contribute to measurement framework design

Assist with attribution model development

Support privacy/compliance strategy work (e.g. cookie consent changes)

Help plan reporting infrastructure

Assist in journey mapping and insights workshops

4. AI Automation (new capability)

Design and build AI-powered automation flows to streamline reporting, data extraction, and routine admin tasks (e.g. using tools like Zapier, Make, n8n, or custom scripts)

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive workflows currently done manually across admin and implementation tasks

Build and maintain automations that pull from analytics platforms (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio) and push into reporting or notification systems

Document automation logic clearly so workflows are maintainable by others on the team

Required Skills & Experience Strong hands-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advanced Looker Studio usage and setup   Experience with event tracking implementation and debugging data discrepancies Comfort pulling data from third-party platforms via APIs , and general familiarity working with API endpoints Understanding of measurement frameworks and attribution modelling Working knowledge of privacy/compliance requirements affecting tracking (e.g. cookie consent) Demonstrated experience building AI automation flows — e.g. Zapier, , n8n, or custom integrations using LLM/API-based tooling Strong documentation habits Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while flagging proactive recommendations Excellent English (written and verbal) — essential Comfortable communicating directly with clients , including handling complex briefs and translating technical detail into clear, client-ready language

Nice to Have Experience managing Google Ads campaigns and reporting on channel performance Prior agency-side experience managing enterprise client relationships Exposure to Python or Java Script for custom automation/scripting

Working Arrangements Must be available Sydney 9:00am–1:00pm (AEST/AEDT) daily for overlap with the Sydney team; remaining hours of the 8-hour day are flexible. Standard client-facing hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00am–1:00pm AEST, excluding public holidays, unless otherwise agreed. Tasks are formally assigned with defined scope and timelines. Deliverables must meet a professional standard and align with the task categories above. Four weeks annual leave, sick leave + 9 days of public holidays. These can be used for your local public holidays if you wish Competitive salary in USD.

Robo Neo ( is landing in Brazil, and we're building a creator community that can turn AI-powered imagination into reality. As our Community Manager, you'll be the one finding brilliant creators, getting them hooked on our tools, and fueling a movement that drives real user growth. This isn't managing an existing group — you'll build it from scratch in one of the most explosive markets for generative AI video. You'll work closely with product, marketing, and growth teams across different countries, and pick up skills that are only going to get more valuable. · Own the relationship from first hello to long-term partnership — run interviews, onboard new creators, and keep the vibe strong with the people who matter most;

· Build and run training that actually helps — design educational flows, share pro tips, and level up the quality of content the community puts out;

· Keep a finger on the pulse with data — track community health every week, pull reports, and turn numbers into smarter moves that boost engagement.

· Portuguese is your native language (or C1+) and you breathe Brazilian internet culture — you know where creators hang out, what formats fly, and what feels fake a mile away;

· You're genuinely curious about AI and content creation — you'd jump at the chance to geek out over new tools and become a product expert;

description:

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?

If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.

About Bueno Law

Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.

We specialize in:

Removal Defense (EOIR). Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS). Family‑Based Immigration.

We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.

Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.). Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions. Manage a removal‑defense caseload, track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records. Prepare hearing packets, organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation. Communicate with clients—often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates. Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy. Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters.

What We’re Looking For

Hard Skills

Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese. 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation). Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills. Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload. Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).

Soft Skills

Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments. Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments. Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused. A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.

Preferred Qualifications

3 + years of immigration paralegal experience. Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.

What We Offer

Competitive pay above market rate. Paid vacation + sick leave. Your birthday off. U. S. paid holidays. Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST. A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

About The Role

SOMO is a Sydney-based performance marketing and digital agency, with a small London presence, hiring a Digital Analytics & Automation Specialist to help deliver on a services agreement with a major client, spanning analytics administration, technical implementation, measurement strategy, and workflow automation. This is a hands-on role covering everyday system hygiene through to building automated processes that reduce manual reporting and operational overhead.

The role is structured around three core service pillars, plus a growing automation function.

Working Hours & Availability

This role reports into a Sydney-based team, so overlap with Sydney business hours is essential :

Core availability window (required): 9:00am–1:00pm Sydney time (AEST/AEDT), every working day The remaining hours of your 8-hour day are flexible and can be worked to suit your own schedule/timezone Given Brazil's timezone difference, this core window will typically fall in the evening to midnight for a Brazil-based hire, candidates should confirm this is workable for them before applying

Key Responsibilities

1. Admin Tasks (system hygiene & operational support)

Manage platform access (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio)

Update dashboard permissions

Set up and maintain scheduled reports/emails

Conduct system hygiene audits

Maintain progress tracking documentation

Acknowledge and resolve routine requests within same-day/1-business-day turnaround

2. Implementation Tasks (technical setup & troubleshooting)

Configure event tracking (form submissions, button clicks, etc.)

Build and maintain dashboards, with a strong emphasis on advanced Looker Studio usage and setup (GA4 also used)

Pull data from third-party platforms via APIs and manage API integrations

Perform ad hoc data extractions

Troubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms

Support integrations with other third-party systems as needed

3. Strategy Tasks (consultative & planning support)

Contribute to measurement framework design

Assist with attribution model development

Support privacy/compliance strategy work (e.g. cookie consent changes)

Help plan reporting infrastructure

Assist in journey mapping and insights workshops

4. AI Automation (new capability)

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (Meta Mask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have Experience with De Fi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Director of strategic partnerships
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of strategic partnerships em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, Fin Techs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.

WHAT YOU WILL DO Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships

WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE 8+ years of B2 B enterprise partnerships experience Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, Di Di, Mercado Pago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, i Food or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia

WHAT WE OFFER Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate Remote-first with regional travel as required Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM

MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

Service Expectations Proactive: Monitor upcoming expirations and data anomalies; flag gaps before they affect the customer Accurate: Get entitlement and data changes right first time, with full traceability Responsive: Provide timely, reliable resolution within standard SLAs Transparent: Give clear visibility into issue status, ownership, and resolution

description:

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.

Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.

What you'll do Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company

What you'll bring

Must-have Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires

Nice-to-have Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.

A Doppa conecta pessoas que querem se tornar criadoras de conteúdo a marcas licenciadas do setor de apostas esportivas e cassino online (i Gaming), um dos segmentos mais aquecidos do mercado digital brasileiro hoje.

title: Remote m&a lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote m&a lawyer - brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Segment manager

Position Details

Job Title: Antenna Sales Manager

Department: Sales — Latin America

Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM

Location: Brazil or Mexico — supporting the LATAM region

Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote (home-office based, customer-facing)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory

Role Objective

Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for antenna products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating antenna design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand antenna penetration within the existing customer base.

Primary Responsibilities

Market Growth & New Business Own LATAM growth for Quectel antenna products and solutions, with a strong focus on new customer acquisition, new verticals, and share expansion. Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential. Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to position antennas alongside modules and connectivity solutions. Develop account strategies for OEMs, ODMs, and EMS providers whose products require cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, or combination antennas.

Customer & Design-Win Development Understand customer applications, RF/connectivity requirements, and program timing, and coordinate the right antenna solution. Track antenna evaluations, samples, technical discussions, qualifications, and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel. Initiate and schedule customer roadmap meetings to identify future programs and influence antenna selection early in the design cycle. Maintain strong follow-up with prospects and customers from initial opportunity through technical evaluation and commercial conversion.

Sales Enablement & Channel Development Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms, and distributors on Quectel antenna positioning, target applications, and sales messages. Create account-specific selling strategies and support local teams in advancing antenna opportunities. Provide competitive and market insights that help the wider sales organization win antenna business.

Product & Internal Collaboration Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, competitive gaps, and future roadmap needs. Translate market feedback into actionable input for product planning and commercial strategy. Coordinate internal resources to move strategic opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.

CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM. Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, meetings, risks, and next steps. Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals, and major customer programs relevant to antenna growth in LATAM. Attend trade shows and industry events to identify target accounts and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.

Qualifications & Experience

What we are looking for (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2 B technical sales, business development, or segment sales within antennas, RF components, wireless connectivity, Io T hardware, or a closely related field. Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts, and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue. Working understanding of customer design cycles and what it takes to win embedded hardware business. Comfort discussing antenna use cases across cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and connected-device applications. Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across a multi-country sales region. Hands-on CRM discipline and clear funnel and business-review reporting. Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English. Willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development, and industry events.

Preferred background Experience selling antennas, RF solutions, Io T modules, or related components to OEM/ODM/EMS customers. Existing relationships within LATAM Io T, industrial, telematics, or tracking ecosystems. Experience supporting distributors, representative firms, or channel partners. Ability to collaborate with Product Management, FAE, and engineering teams on technical evaluations. Familiarity with certification and homologation processes in LATAM markets (e.g., ANATEL, IFT).

What Success Looks Like Growth in qualified antenna pipeline and new target accounts. Increase in antenna design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions. Higher antenna penetration across existing Quectel accounts. Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through. Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting. Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.

About Quectel

Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate Io T innovation. We are an end-to-end global Io T solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing.

Industries & Applications

Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across:

Smart metering and utilities Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics Smart agriculture Smart cities and infrastructure Industrial Io T and automation Connected mobility and automotive Smart home and consumer Io T

Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths. Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5 G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications. Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with Io T experts across engineering, sales, and operations.

Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory Meal and grocery vouchers Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents Dental coverage Life insurance and accident cover Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization

Learn More

Explore products, careers, and news at or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on Linked In.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.

Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Data specialist (with advanced english)

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

About the Role:

We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!

As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.

You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.
