title: Remote m&a lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote m&a lawyer - brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros). CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.

Por que se juntar a nós?

Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:

Somos totalmente focados em crescimento. Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade. Vencemos juntos, com diversão. Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria. Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente. Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.

Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!

Oferecemos Cargos com verdadeira responsabilidade e impacto visível. Liberdade para agir com rapidez, experimentar e desafiar a forma como as coisas são feitas. Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce. Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.

VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?

Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para contratação independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, origem nacional ou qualquer outra condição protegida pela legislação aplicável. title: Remote commercial lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote commercial lawyer - brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Remote m&a lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote m&a lawyer - brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Senior fpga developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior fpga developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.

About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.

Responsibilities :

The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.

Qualifications :

BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.

Required Skills :

Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.

Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Data specialist (with advanced english)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data specialist (with advanced english) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us:

Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

About the Role:

We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!

As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.

You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Segment manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Segment manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Details

Job Title: Antenna Sales Manager

Department: Sales — Latin America

Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM

Location: Brazil or Mexico — supporting the LATAM region

Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote (home-office based, customer-facing)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory

Role Objective

Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for antenna products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating antenna design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand antenna penetration within the existing customer base.

Primary Responsibilities

Market Growth & New Business Own LATAM growth for Quectel antenna products and solutions, with a strong focus on new customer acquisition, new verticals, and share expansion. Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential. Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to position antennas alongside modules and connectivity solutions. Develop account strategies for OEMs, ODMs, and EMS providers whose products require cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, or combination antennas.

Customer & Design-Win Development Understand customer applications, RF/connectivity requirements, and program timing, and coordinate the right antenna solution. Track antenna evaluations, samples, technical discussions, qualifications, and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel. Initiate and schedule customer roadmap meetings to identify future programs and influence antenna selection early in the design cycle. Maintain strong follow-up with prospects and customers from initial opportunity through technical evaluation and commercial conversion.

Sales Enablement & Channel Development Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms, and distributors on Quectel antenna positioning, target applications, and sales messages. Create account-specific selling strategies and support local teams in advancing antenna opportunities. Provide competitive and market insights that help the wider sales organization win antenna business.

Product & Internal Collaboration Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, competitive gaps, and future roadmap needs. Translate market feedback into actionable input for product planning and commercial strategy. Coordinate internal resources to move strategic opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.

CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM. Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, meetings, risks, and next steps. Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals, and major customer programs relevant to antenna growth in LATAM. Attend trade shows and industry events to identify target accounts and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.

Qualifications & Experience

What we are looking for (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2 B technical sales, business development, or segment sales within antennas, RF components, wireless connectivity, Io T hardware, or a closely related field. Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts, and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue. Working understanding of customer design cycles and what it takes to win embedded hardware business. Comfort discussing antenna use cases across cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and connected-device applications. Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across a multi-country sales region. Hands-on CRM discipline and clear funnel and business-review reporting. Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English. Willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development, and industry events.

Preferred background Experience selling antennas, RF solutions, Io T modules, or related components to OEM/ODM/EMS customers. Existing relationships within LATAM Io T, industrial, telematics, or tracking ecosystems. Experience supporting distributors, representative firms, or channel partners. Ability to collaborate with Product Management, FAE, and engineering teams on technical evaluations. Familiarity with certification and homologation processes in LATAM markets (e.g., ANATEL, IFT).

What Success Looks Like Growth in qualified antenna pipeline and new target accounts. Increase in antenna design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions. Higher antenna penetration across existing Quectel accounts. Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through. Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting. Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.

About Quectel

Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate Io T innovation. We are an end-to-end global Io T solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing.

Industries & Applications

Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across:

Smart metering and utilities Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics Smart agriculture Smart cities and infrastructure Industrial Io T and automation Connected mobility and automotive Smart home and consumer Io T

Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths. Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5 G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications. Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with Io T experts across engineering, sales, and operations.

Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory Meal and grocery vouchers Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents Dental coverage Life insurance and accident cover Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization

Learn More

Explore products, careers, and news at or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on Linked In.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.

Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Remote commercial lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote commercial lawyer - brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo writer (brasil) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Promo Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.

Role Overview

As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.

The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.

You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.

Key Responsibilities

1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series.

2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts.

3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards.

4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution.

5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance.

6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response.

7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.

Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.

They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M& A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration. Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses. 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house. How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do Zero Layer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células). Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider. Estabelecer padrões de Ia C (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável). Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada. Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs. Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

Larga experiência em Arquitetura de Soluções, Arquitetura de Software ou Cloud Architecture. Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud. Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map. Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção. APIs REST, g RPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos. Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes. Bancos relacionais, No SQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding. OAuth2, Open ID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade. Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs). Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs. Experiência no setor Financeiro

Desejável:

Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture. CQRS. Event Sourcing. Saga Pattern. Outbox Pattern. Consumer Driven Contracts. Graph QL. Apache Pulsar, Rabbit MQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria. Java, Go ou. NET. Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS). Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102). TOGAF. Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas. Conhecimento de Terraform

Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições; Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento; Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina; Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ; Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ; Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

title: Remote privacy lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote privacy lawyer - brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's privacy and data protection work in Brazil: GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliance, data processing agreements, international data transfers, DPIAs, and marketing and cookie compliance. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, joint controller arrangements, and privacy terms in commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. Advise clients on the privacy implications of deploying AI systems — training data, automated decision-making, transparency obligations, and the intersection of data protection law with the EU AI Act and equivalents. Support incident response — breach assessment, notification obligations, regulator engagement, and remediation. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising privacy or data protection law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, and ideally one or more of: HIPAA, financial services data rules, or sector-specific regimes. International transfers expertise. SCCs, transfer impact assessments, adequacy decisions, and the practical mechanics of cross-border data flows. Working knowledge of AI and privacy. Training data, profiling, automated decision-making, and where the EU AI Act meets the GDPR. A practical, risk-based approach. You translate regulatory requirements into decisions a product team can act on. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E or similar) are a plus. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Work on the privacy frontier of AI deployment — not just commenting on it, but operationalizing compliance for real products. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada. Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. APIs REST, g RPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos. Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes. Bancos relacionais, No SQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding. OAuth2, Open ID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade. Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs). Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs. Experiência no setor Financeiro

Desejável:

Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture. CQRS. Event Sourcing. Saga Pattern. Outbox Pattern. Consumer Driven Contracts. Graph QL. Apache Pulsar, Rabbit MQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria. Java, Go ou. NET. Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS). Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102). TOGAF. Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas. Conhecimento de Terraform

Descrição comportamental:

About Us

Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.

At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.

Role Overview

As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.

2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.

3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble

4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.

5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.

6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.

7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.

8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology

9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.

10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery

Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.

Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.

Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.

Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.

Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English

This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Senior ai agent engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ai agent engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About First Ignite

First Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research

coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.

The role

We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea

whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.

What you'll do

• Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,

included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,

Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

• Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems

are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.

• Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect

entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.

• Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to

Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.

Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.

• Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

• Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.

• Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

• Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

• Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.

Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

• You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

• You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

• You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

• You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

• You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

• You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question

being asked instead of a nearby one.

• You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

• You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

• You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

You might currently be titled

AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI

Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI

Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll

go on what you've shipped.

Preferred Qualifications:

• You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.

• You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AI

Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.

• You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.

• You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.

• You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Remote investment lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote investment lawyer - brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side. Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion. Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents. Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits. Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds. Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: Remote real estate lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote real estate lawyer - brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios. Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M& A and financing transactions. Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house. Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments. Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics. Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals. Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms
