description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior fpga developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.

About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.

Responsibilities :

The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.

Qualifications :

BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.

Required Skills :

Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.

Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Head of business & operations (brazil resident)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of business & operations (brazil resident) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.

Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.

What you'll do Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company

What you'll bring

Must-have Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires

Nice-to-have Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo writer (brasil) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Promo Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.

Role Overview

As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.

The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.

You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.

Key Responsibilities

1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series.

2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts.

3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards.

4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution.

5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance.

6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response.

7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.

Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.

They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Remote investment lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote investment lawyer - brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side. Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion. Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents. Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits. Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds. Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

Por que se juntar a nós?

Somos totalmente focados em crescimento. Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade. Vencemos juntos, com diversão. Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria. Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente. Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.

Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce. Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.

VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo writer (brasil) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Promo Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.

Role Overview

As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.

The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.

You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.

Key Responsibilities

1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series.

2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts.

3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards.

4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution.

5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance.

6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response.

7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.

Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.

They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

description:

Somos uma empresa 100% familiar (mais concretamente, uma família de mais de 30.000 colaboradores). Estamos presentes em 35 países e a nossa sede é em Palma de Maiorca. Os nossos valores (Paixão, Responsabilidade, Transparência, Criatividade e Humildade) são muito importantes para nós e todas as nossas ações estão alinhadas com eles. Somos pioneiros no turismo sustentável (veja o nosso movimento Wave of Change para saber mais).

Se isto lhe parece interessante... este pode ser o lugar certo para você! :)

Quais serão suas principais funções?

Responsável por planejar, desenvolver e executar estratégias de gestão de pessoas, conduzindo ações de recrutamento e seleção, desenvolvimento de colaboradores, programas de avaliação de desempenho, retenção de talentos e iniciativas de diversidade e inclusão. Atua como suporte às lideranças, acompanha indicadores de RH e contribui para o fortalecimento da cultura organizacional e dos resultados da empresa.

Como será o seu dia?

Recrutamento e Seleção:

Conduzir e coordenar processos seletivos para cargos de gerência e vice-diretoria, aplicando metodologias e ferramentas avançadas para identificar os melhores talentos. Auxiliar e fornecer suporte estratégico às equipes de Recursos Humanos e gestão nas atividades de recrutamento e seleção, otimizando o processo e garantindo sua eficácia. Garantir que os processos de seleção sejam alinhados com os objetivos organizacionais, identificando as competências e características ideais para cada posição estratégica.

Treinamento e Desenvolvimento:

Análise de Necessidades de Treinamento

Realizar uma análise aprofundada das lacunas de habilidades e conhecimentos dos colaboradores, identificando áreas críticas para o desenvolvimento organizacional. Conduzir entrevistas com líderes e colaboradores para entender as necessidades de treinamento específicas de cada área e função. Analisar dados de desempenho, avaliações e feedbacks para identificar as principais áreas que exigem capacitação. Desenvolver planos de ação baseados nas necessidades de treinamento, priorizando aquelas mais alinhadas com os objetivos organizacionais e de crescimento.

Desenvolvimento de Programas de Treinamento

Responsável pelo processo de Indução de novos colaboradores, realizando as programações e acompanhamentos necessários. Projetar e implementar programas de treinamento personalizados para diferentes níveis hierárquicos, como o Programa de Desenvolvimento de Líderes (PDL). Criar conteúdos de treinamento inovadores, incluindo manuais, apresentações, vídeos e recursos digitais para facilitar o aprendizado. Adotar metodologias de treinamento inovadoras, como gamificação e simulações, para aumentar o engajamento e a eficácia dos programas. Desenvolver programas de treinamento tanto online quanto presenciais, atendendo às diversas necessidades de aprendizagem.

Implementação de Treinamentos

Coordenar todos os aspectos logísticos dos treinamentos, como definição de local, data e horários, garantindo uma execução tranquila e eficiente. Facilitar os treinamentos, estimulando a interação e o engajamento dos participantes, e utilizando ferramentas de avaliação para medir a eficácia. Fornecer feedback contínuo aos participantes e ajustar os programas conforme necessário para maximizar os resultados. Assegurar que todos os treinamentos estejam alinhados às políticas organizacionais e regulamentações internas.

Avaliação e Relatórios

Medir a eficácia dos programas de treinamento utilizando avaliações de desempenho, feedback dos colaboradores e indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs). Analisar os dados de avaliação para identificar áreas de melhoria e sugerir ações corretivas para otimizar os programas. Apresentar relatórios detalhados sobre os resultados dos treinamentos e seu impacto nos objetivos organizacionais, com recomendações para futuras melhorias.

Programa de Acompanhamento de Novos Colaboradores

Acompanhar o desempenho dos novos colaboradores, proporcionando suporte contínuo para superar desafios e garantir uma integração bem-sucedida. Fornecer feedback regular sobre o progresso dos novos colaboradores e sugerir ajustes no programa de integração conforme necessário. Avaliar periodicamente a eficácia do programa de acompanhamento e implementar melhorias com base no feedback dos novos colaboradores e gestores.

Programas do RH:

Ouvidoria (RH com Você!)

Gerenciar e analisar as demandas da ouvidoria, garantindo que as solicitações sejam atendidas com clareza, rapidez e confidencialidade. Identificar padrões e tendências nas demandas e elaborar relatórios com recomendações para melhorias nas políticas e práticas organizacionais. Garantir a confidencialidade e o sigilo nas tratativas, mantendo a confiança dos colaboradores no processo.

Gestão de Conflitos

Atendimento colaboradores e resolução/acompanhamento de conflitos.

Comitê da Diversidade

Planejar, apoiar e acompanhar as ações do Comitê da Diversidade, promovendo iniciativas voltadas à inclusão, equidade e respeito às diferenças. Desenvolver campanhas, eventos e ações de conscientização sobre diversidade e inclusão. Apoiar a implementação de políticas e boas práticas que fortaleçam uma cultura organizacional diversa e inclusiva. Monitorar indicadores e elaborar relatórios sobre as iniciativas do comitê, propondo ações de melhoria contínua.

Criação e Atualização de Descritivos de Cargos

Realizar análise detalhada das funções existentes na organização, documentando as principais responsabilidades, tarefas e objetivos de cada cargo. Desenvolver e criar descritivos de cargos claros, concisos e precisos, garantindo que reflitam com precisão as exigências das funções. Atualizar periodicamente os descritivos de cargos, considerando mudanças organizacionais, tecnológicas ou de mercado, e assegurando que eles permaneçam relevantes. Trabalhar em colaboração com líderes, gerentes e colaboradores para validar e refinar os descritivos, garantindo que estejam alinhados com as necessidades reais da organização.

Benefícios:

Realizar e otimizar a administração de benefícios, garantindo que todos os colaboradores sejam corretamente incluídos ou excluídos conforme as demandas. Realizar a gestão de benefícios como assistência médica, odontológica, vale-transporte, farmácia, cesta básica, entre outros, e garantir a conformidade com as políticas da empresa. Realizar a comunicação interna sobre os benefícios, esclarecendo dúvidas dos colaboradores e garantindo que todas as informações sejam entregues de maneira clara e acessível.

Gestão de Desligamento e Retenção:

Conduzir entrevistas de desligamento com foco na análise dos fatores que influenciam a saída dos colaboradores, e apresentar relatórios com insights para gestores. Desenvolver e implementar estratégias para retenção de talentos, monitorando a satisfação dos colaboradores e implementando ações para engajamento contínuo.

Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Gestão de Desempenho:

Mapear as necessidades de treinamento e desenvolvimento da organização, desenvolvendo programas e estratégias para suprir as lacunas identificadas. Conduzir e implementar programas de desenvolvimento de carreira, com foco no aprimoramento contínuo dos colaboradores e liderança interna. Atuar como consultor estratégico para a liderança, oferecendo suporte no desenvolvimento de equipes de alta performance e na implementação de mudanças organizacionais.

Indicadores de Desempenho e Relatórios:

Acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados a recrutamento, seleção, desenvolvimento e retenção de talentos. Gerar relatórios e apresentações analíticos que forneçam insights valiosos para a liderança, com foco em melhorar continuamente os processos de gestão de pessoas.

O que é necessário para ter sucesso nesta função?

Formação: Superior completo - graduação em Administração, Psicologia, Comunicação ou áreas afins. Desejável: Pós-graduação na área de Gestão de Pessoas, Endomarketing ou especialização na área de Recursos Humanos. Conhecimento avançado em Processos de Recrutamento e Seleção, Treinamento e Desenvolvimento, Cargos, Carreira e Remuneração. Experiência comprovada na gestão de programas de diversidade e inclusão, engajamento e retenção.

Idiomas

Português nativo ou avançado.

Alguns dos nossos benefícios:

Trabalhar em um ambiente inspirador que aposta nas pessoas, nos valores e em um modelo de turismo responsável. Pacote de remuneração competitivo, com benefícios atrativos. Oportunidade de progressão dentro da empresa: uma variedade de oportunidades e projetos. que permitirão desenvolver seu potencial e crescer profissionalmente. Alimentação no refeitório da empresa; Auxilio Alimentação; Transporte fretado da empresa; Assistência médica após 01 ano de contratação (com co-participação); Assistência odontológica (com mensalidade); Day off (folga)no dia aniversário Seguro de vida.

description:

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Head of business & operations (brazil resident)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of business & operations (brazil resident) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.

Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.

What you'll do Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company

What you'll bring

Must-have Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires

Nice-to-have Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

description:

About Us

Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.

At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.

Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.

Role Overview

As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.

2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.

3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble

4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.

5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.

6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.

7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.

8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology

9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.

10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery

Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.

Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.

Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.

Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.

Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English

This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.

Role Overview

As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.

2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.

3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble

4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.

5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.

6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.

7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.

8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology

9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.

10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery

Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.

Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.

Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.

Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.

Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English

This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M& A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration. Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses. Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements; represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief. Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions). Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up. Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Exército abre concurso com vagas para farmacêuticos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Exército abre concurso com vagas para farmacêuticos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Exército abre concurso com vagas para farmacêuticos

O Exército abriu concurso para diversas vagas de nível superior no Curso de Formação de Oficiais de Saúde (CFO/S Sal), sendo cinco vagas reservadas para futuros oficiais farmacêuticos, de ambos os sexos. As inscrições poderão ser feitas entre 16 de junho e 4 de agosto.

Além de curso superior nas áreas da saúde oferecidas no concurso, é necessário que o candidato tenha idade de no máximo 32 anos para as áreas de farmácia, medicina sem especialidade e odontologia e 34 anos para a área de medicina com especialidade. Além de ter no mínimo, 1,60m de altura se do sexo masculino, e 1,55m se do sexo feminino.

De acordo com o edital , os candidatos serão submetidos a exame intelectual, verificação documental preliminar, inspeção de saúde, exame de aptidão física, avaliação psicológica e revisão médica e comprovação dos requisitos para a matrícula. O exame intelectual tem previsão de ser aplicado em 12 de setembro.

O curso de formação será realizado na Escola de Formação Complementar do Exército (EsFCEx), em Salvador (BA), com duração aproximada de 37 semanas. As inscrições, cuja taxa é de R$ 150, poderão ser feitas no site da EsFCEx .

De acordo com o edital, estará isento da taxa de inscrição o candidato que comprove ser doador de medula óssea em entidades reconhecidas pelo Ministério da Saúde ou pertença a família inscrita no Cadastro Único para Programas Sociais do Governo Federal (CadÚnico), cuja renda familiar mensal per capita seja inferior ou igual a meio salário-mínimo nacional.

Após concluir o curso com aproveitamento, executando todas as medidas administrativas e de ensino pertinentes, assim como a escolha de vaga, o concludente será nomeado oficial do Exército Brasileiro no posto de primeiro-tenente do Serviço de Saúde.

Segundo o farmacêutico Rafael Poloni, os profissionais graduados em Farmácia que desejam passar em concursos ou processos seletivos em órgãos públicos precisam seguir uma regra básica: estudar. Ele, que também é professor da pós-graduação em Farmácia Clínica e Prescrição Farmacêutica no ICTQ – Instituto de Pesquisa e Pós-Graduação para o Mercado Farmacêutico, dá dicas para os colegas de profissão que pretendem concorrer.

O farmacêutico sugere que os candidatos foquem em editais ou provas anteriores para treinar e fazer muitos exercícios. Outra dica é focar nas disciplinas que ele tem mais dificuldades.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Rio de Janeiro, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local;Educação para o consumo consciente de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O (a) Promotor Social (a) terá como principal atividade conduzir as palestras sobre consumo consciente e stand de troca de lâmpadas, disseminando informações sobre uso eficiente da energia, esclarecendo dúvidas, orientando os clientes e realizando a substituição de lâmpadas ineficientes por lâmpadas econômicas. É necessaria disponibilidade para viagem no interior do estado do RJ.

title: Banco de Talentos - Pessoa Técnica de Enfermagem/ VAGA EXTERNA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Banco de Talentos - Pessoa Técnica de Enfermagem/ VAGA EXTERNA em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Banco de Talentos - Pessoa Técnica de Enfermagem/ VAGA EXTERNA

Quem Somos
A Holiste é uma clínica psiquiátrica criada para promover a saúde mental, oferecendo aos pacientes e suas famílias todos os recursos da psiquiatria moderna.

Missão
Oferecer às pessoas com transtornos mentais e seus familiares um serviço de saúde mental abrangente e de qualidade, buscando sua reabilitação e ressocialização, fortalecendo a relação de confiança e respeito com nossos pacientes e colaboradores.

Visão
Ser referência no tratamento em Saúde Mental do Brasil.

Valores

  • Liberdade - A Liberdade é o nosso principal valor. Acreditamos na liberdade de pensamento, na livre iniciativa e na liberdade de escolha. À exceção dos incapazes, ninguém deve ser tutelado por terceiros ou pelo estado. O portador de transtorno mental deve ser tratado para exercer plenamente sua cidadania, estar ciente do seu livre arbítrio e do seu dever de escolher, ele próprio, o que é melhor para sua vida.
  • O paciente como prioridade - Nosso compromisso maior é com o bem-estar de nossos pacientes e de suas famílias, e não com protocolos e regulamentações. Assim, estamos sempre alinhados com as mais modernas terapêuticas disponíveis no mundo, com a finalidade de proporcionar o melhor tratamento aos nossos pacientes.
  • O empoderamento do paciente - Para nós, o paciente com transtorno mental não é um incapaz, mas um cidadão pleno. O paciente é visto como alguém que pode exercer direito de escolha e responsabilidade sobre sua própria saúde.
  • O profissional de Saúde no comando - A Holiste foi criada e é dirigida por profissionais da Saúde Mental. A atuação diária envolve uma prática que favorece o bem-estar dos pacientes e de suas famílias, com cada paciente possuindo um psiquiatra e um psicólogo de referência.
  • Assistência psiquiátrica integrada - A psiquiatria moderna trabalha em equipe, integrando conhecimentos de diversas áreas para o cuidado do paciente.
  • Atendimento personalizado - Cada paciente possui um plano terapêutico individualizado, montado para atender às suas reais necessidades.
  • Compromisso ético - Servir bem é o objetivo, com ética como qualidade e base do relacionamento com pacientes e familiares.

Requisitos

Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar, executar e avaliar a assistência de enfermagem
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem segura, humanizada e individualizada aos pacientes, sob supervisão do Enfermeiro
  • Orientar e preparar os clientes para exames e procedimentos (Internados e ambulatorial) - ECT e cetamina
  • Realizar exames segundo instruções médicas como ECG (Eletrocardiograma), Teste Toxicológico e/ou teste de alcoolemia
  • Preparar e administrar medicações por via oral, tópica, intradérmica, subcutânea, intramuscular, endovenosa e retal, conforme prescrição médica
  • Participar de resgates (homem), administração de medicação no ambulatório, administração de medicação domiciliar
  • Aferir sinais vitais diariamente e registrar em prontuário, bem como rotinas fisiológicas, informando qualquer alteração ao enfermeiro
  • Auxiliar o Enfermeiro e/ou médico
  • Realizar registro de enfermagem diário no prontuário dos clientes pertinentes ao processo terapêutico, bem como registro dos materiais e medicamentos utilizados
  • Participar junto à equipe de cuidadores e enfermeiros nos procedimentos como rondas nos quartos, revistas de pacientes na admissão e retorno de licenças, supervisão e auxílio de banho, higiene e troca de fralda; assistir os pacientes em todas as refeições
  • Vigilância de pacientes: cuidados com comportamentos de risco e situações de urgência
  • Manter equipamentos e a unidade de trabalho organizada, zelando pela sua conservação e comunicando ao superior eventuais problemas
  • Participar de programas de treinamento e aperfeiçoamento, quando convocado
  • Guardar sigilo das informações inerentes às atribuições do cargo
  • Identificar e solicitar materiais e medicamentos dos pacientes, quando necessário para o enfermeiro
  • Informar qualquer não conformidade para o enfermeiro ou gestor direto
  • Demais atividades pertinentes à função

Competência Técnica

  • Técnico de Enfermagem / Coren ativo
  • Experiência comprovada para atuar na área assistencial
  • Atuar em escala 12x36

O Que Esperamos de Você

  • Tranquilidade
  • Boa comunicação
  • Resolutivo
  • Participativo
  • Atento
  • Observador
  • Perspicaz
  • Facilidade de trabalho em equipe

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica - Coparticipativa (mensalidade de R$ 75,00 + 30% se uso)
  • Assistência Odontológica - R$ 28,00
  • Transporte
  • Convênio CIEB
  • Alimentação

  • Realizar o cálculo e o pagamento de férias, 13º salário e demais verbas trabalhistas.
  • Manter atualizado o sistema de folha de pagamento, garantindo a precisão dos dados.

Atualização Cadastral

  • Manter atualizados os dados cadastrais dos colaboradores nos sistemas da empresa.
  • Coletar e registrar informações sobre mudanças de cargo, salário e outros dados relevantes.
  • Garantir a confidencialidade e a segurança dos dados dos colaboradores.

Gestão de Desligamentos

  • Experience analyzing engagement and performance metrics across digital channels;
  • Familiarity with survey analytics (e.g., pulse surveys, eNPS) and combining behavioral and attitudinal data;
  • Exposure to analytics for employee communications platforms (e.g., intranet, email platforms, internal messaging tools);
  • Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience designing advanced data visualizations in Tableau;
  • Experience with Python for exploratory analysis or data manipulation.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Experiência comprovada mínima acima de 7 anos atuando na área de manutenção de equipamentos dinâmicos;

Desejável experiência em unidades operacionais de processamento de gás, refinarias, fábrica de fertilizantes e/ou petroquímica;

Desejável conhecimento em SAP e softwares esepecificos de análises na sua área de ênfase.

  • Capacitação para o uso das seguintes ferramentas: Word, Excel, PowerPoint. Esta comprovação poderá ser dada mediante certificados de realização de cursos ou declaração de que o profissional trabalhou com o uso destas ferramentas pelo menos durante mesmo periodo de sua experiencia profissional.

title: Azure Data Engineer - Remote, Latin America
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Azure Data Engineer - Remote, Latin America em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • ETL Data Engineering: Develop and maintain ETL data engineering processes using Python (PySpark) within Azure Synapse Analytics Notebooks, and/or Azure Synapse Analytics Pipelines, to ensure efficient data extractions, transformation, and loading.
  • Data Warehousing: Apply your expertise in data warehousing, understanding star schemas, facts, and dimensions, to design and build effective data storage structures in a Massively Parallel Processing (MPP) SWL Pool.
  • Data Source Expertise: Extract data from various sources, including REST APIs, SWL database tables, and CSV files.
  • Azure Synapse Analytics Expertise: Utilize your deep knowledge of Azure Synapse Analytics to design and optimize data notebooks/pipelines for scalability and performance.
  • Data Fabric Concepts: Contribute to the implementation and understanding of other Data Fabric concepts, such as data lakes, lakehouses, delta lakes, and data cataloging, to enhance data management capabilities.
  • Data Modeling: Collaborate with data architects to create data models and schemas that align with business requirements.
  • Data Quality: Implement data quality checks and validation processes to maintain data accuracy and consistency.
  • Performance Tuning: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and optimize ETL data notebooks/pipelines to meet SLAs.
  • Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Monitoring ETL jobs, diagnose issues, and implement solutions to ensure data pipeline reliability.
  • Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of ETL data engineering processes, data flows, and data transformations.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and provide support for data-related initiatives.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure data security and compliance with data governance and privacy standards.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent work experience, with certifications related to data engineering or data science (e.g. Azure Data Engineer) being a plus.
  • Proven experience in ETL data engineering with significant expertise in using Python (PySpark) to perform data extraction, transformation, and loading from REST APIs, SQL database tables, and CSV files.
  • Proficiency in using Azure Synapse Analytics resources including Notebooks, Pipelines, Linked Services, and Azure Key Vault.
  • Demonstrated ability to write complex SQL queries, optimize query performance, and work with both SparkSQL and MS SQL to effectively extract, transform, and load data.
  • Knowledge of data integration best practices and tools.
  • Experience with version control systems, such as Git (Azure DevOps).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a keen attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with shifting priorities.
  • Familiarity with big data technologies, machine learning, and data analysis preferred.
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) and Agile Methodologies a plus.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer ID66319
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer ID66319 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to build and maintain cloud-native applications using React on the frontend and Node.js and C# on the backend, deployed across a deep AWS infrastructure including Lambda, ECS, SQS, and EventBridge. You will design scalable data solutions across Postgres, DynamoDB, and SQL, write comprehensive tests with Jest and Playwright, and own infrastructure as code using Terraform and GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Develop, architect, and deliver high-quality full-stack features using modern frameworks such as React, Node.js, and C#, working closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Design and develop scalable, high-performance cloud-native products by building and maintaining serverless and containerized services within the AWS ecosystem and implementing efficient data storage solutions such as Postgres, DynamoDB, and SQL.
  • Ensure code quality and system stability by writing comprehensive tests using Jest and Playwright, and contributing to infrastructure‑as‑code and CI/CD processes using Terraform and GitLab.

MUST HAVES

  • 5+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer
  • Proficiency in React
  • Experience with Node.js and C#
  • Expertise in Postgres, AWS Dynamo, and SQL
  • Deep hands‑on experience with core AWS services, including SQS, Lambda, ECS, CloudFront, ALB, and EventBridge
  • Strong experience with Jest and Playwright
  • Experience with Terraform and GitLab
  • Excellent problem‑solving and communication skills for working collaboratively with technical leads and product managers
  • Upper‑intermediate English level

NICE TO HAVES

  • Knowledge of containerization tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and serverless computing patterns
  • Experience with other front‑end frameworks and libraries such as Angular or Vue.js
  • Background in financial services or industry‑specific knowledge
  • Experience with performance profiling or monitoring tools

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth : Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps
  • Competitive compensation : USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets
  • Exciting projects : Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies
  • Flextime : Flexible schedule with remote and office options

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência em finanças e/ou administrativo, preferencialmente em startups ou empresas de tecnologia

  • Domínio avançado de Excel ou Google Sheets
  • Perfil hands‑on com capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia

Será diferencial se você tiver:

  • Vivência com marketplaces ou múltiplas unidades de negócio

  • Experiência com processos de fundraising
  • Pós‑graduação ou MBA

Benefícios:

  • Auxílio educação (mediante aprovação baseada em política interna)

  • Horário flexível

Respeitamos as diferenças. Cada uma das pessoas candidatas — sem distinção de raça, etnia, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade — é muito bem‑vinda.

Confira esta oportunidade para CONSULTOR(A) TÉCNICO(A) COMERCIAL (PRODUÇÃO ANIMAL) - FEIRA DE SANTANA / BA em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Ser um Consultor Técnico Comercial na TIMAC Agro é muito mais do que atuar com vendas. Aqui você trabalha lado a lado com o produtor , levando tecnologia, conhecimento e soluções que impactam diretamente a produtividade a campo. Você terá autonomia para desenvolver sua região, construir relações de confiança com os produtores e acompanhar de perto os resultados das tecnologias aplicadas. Além disso, fará parte de uma das maiores e mais qualificadas equipes técnicas do agro brasileiro , com acesso a inovação, suporte técnico e oportunidades reais de crescimento. Se você gosta de desafios, de estar no campo e de gerar resultados concretos, essa pode ser a oportunidade que vai acelerar sua carreira no agro.

O que você vai fazer

Como Consultor Técnico Comercial, você será protagonista no desenvolvimento da sua região de atuação, trabalhando diretamente com produtores rurais.

  • Atuar como Consultor Técnico: Entender a realidade do produtor, analisar solo, histórico produtivo, manejo e recomendar as melhores soluções.
  • Desenvolver e fortalecer sua carteira de clientes: Construir relações de confiança, proximidade e identificar novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Acompanhar resultados no campo: Monitorar aplicações, desenvolvimento das lavouras ou animais e avaliar os resultados de produtividade.
  • Participar de ações técnicas e comerciais: Dias de campo, palestras e eventos junto à equipe regional.
  • Gerar relatórios técnicos e comparativos: Demonstrar os resultados obtidos com as tecnologias TIMAC.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Agronomia, Zootecnia, Medicina Veterinária, Técnico Agrícola ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comercial com vendas no agronegócio CNH válida.
  • Conhecimento da região de atuação.

O que você encontra na TIMAC Agro

Na TIMAC Agro você encontra um ambiente que valoriza pessoas, resultados e desenvolvimento profissional.

Oferecemos

  • Salário fixo + comissões sem limite de ganho
  • Vale alimentação ou refeição
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Seguro de vida

Ferramentas para você trabalhar e crescer

Para que você possa focar no que realmente importa — gerar resultado no campo — a TIMAC fornece:

  • Veículo de trabalho
  • Cartão combustível
  • Celular corporativo
  • Tablet com internet
